parameters.name: ConnectionStringPrefix
parameters.description:
The prefix of the public endpoint. The prefix must start with a lowercase letter and can contain lowercase letters and digits. The prefix can be 8 to 40 characters in length.

>  The endpoint is in the `<prefix>.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com` format.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The service port number of the instance. Valid values: **1024** to **65535**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore allocate-instance-public-connection --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --connection-string-prefix r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --port 6379 --region cn-hangzhou
